## Summary

<!-- What changed and why. PR title must follow Commitizen (e.g. `agent: ...`, `feat: ...`) as it becomes the squash commit. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `agent` - agent definition / prompt
- [ ] `feat` - new stage, capability or target
- [ ] `tweak` - minor behaviour change, too small for a feature
- [ ] `fix` / `refactor` / `test` / `build` / `chore` / `docs`

## Validation

- [ ] `gh aw compile` run and `.lock.yml` files committed (if workflows changed)
- [ ] Tested against a target repo (link run)
